name: CPD S.A.
summary: Operating through its subsidiaries, CPD S.A. is a real estate firm primarily engaged in developing and selling office, residential, and warehouse properties. Its business scope covers both Poland and international markets, also encompassing land acquisition and building construction. Founded in 1999 and headquartered in Warsaw, Poland, the company was formerly known as Celtic Property Developments S.A., changing to its current designation in September 2014.
